sourceDocuments.name: Morrow rules
sourceDocuments.text: Morrow is a fictional tabletop game. The circular board has eight spaces numbered 0 through 7. Moving forward from 7 wraps to 0. On each turn choose exactly one action: move forward one or two spaces, gather one blue token without moving, or exchange tokens. Blue tokens are capped at three; any excess is lost. Landing on a beacon at space 2 or 6 earns one blue token. Passing a beacon earns nothing. Exchanging is allowed only at space 4 and trades two blue tokens for one gold token without moving. A player with fewer than two blue tokens cannot exchange. Gold tokens cannot be spent and have no cap. All players start at space 0 with zero tokens. At the end, score two points per gold token plus one point per blue token. Position itself earns no points.
